# VixForge Interactive

> Avatar shaders and Unity editor tooling for VRChat, made by Vixenlicious.
> Everything targets Unity 2022.3 on the Built-in Render Pipeline, for VRChat
> on desktop PC. There is no Quest or Android build, and no URP or HDRP build.
> The Vixens Toolbox editor suite and two of the four shaders are free.

## Shaders

- [VixenWear Latex Ultra](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/products.html#latex-ultra): dual-lobe GGX shader for latex, vinyl and other synthetic materials. Clearcoat, thin-film, wet and drip, melting goo, triple matcaps, and live reactions to AudioLink, LTCGI, VRC Light Volumes and VRSL. Free on Gumroad.
- [VixForge Toon](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/products.html#vixforge-toon): cel and anime shader with rebuilt outlines, sharing the same lighting stack. Translates materials across from lilToon, Poiyomi or VRChat Toon Standard in one click. Free on Gumroad.
- [VixenWear Clothing Pro](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/products.html#clothing-pro): fabric shader with a soft grazing-angle sheen, surface fur, geometry fur, and a 72-fabric Material Type picker. Patreon membership, 35 USD a month.
- [VixForge Fur Pro](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/products.html#fur-pro): geometry fur where each hair is one continuous strand, with self shadowing, guard hairs, tufting, and a scene-view comb brush. Patreon membership, 15 USD a month.

## Start here

- [Products and pricing](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/products.html): all four shaders, what each one is for, where to get it, and the questions people ask before buying.
- [Shader documentation](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/shaderdocs.html): what every inspector control does, section by section, in plain language.
- [VPM registry and install](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/): adding the Vixens Toolbox to the VRChat Creator Companion.
- [List of tools](https://vixencreations.github.io/VixenToolBox/tools.html): the editor tools in the Vixens Toolbox, including the Quest Conversion Engine and the Avatar Optimization Suite.

## Licensing

- VixenWear Latex Ultra and VixForge Toon are free and open. Personal and commercial use is allowed, including shipping them inside a paid avatar base, as long as the copyright headers stay in the files and the package is not resold on its own.
- VixenWear Clothing Pro and VixForge Fur Pro are supporter-only and may not be redistributed.
